description: Default duel strategy for a team of 2-4. P1 runs Default Team Hitter: AoE in round 1 of a mob fight, otherwise it buffs while a buff adds to the next hit, then hits. The others attack in round 1 of a mob fight; otherwise they buff P1 and trap the boss, and pass rather than spend P1's buffs. Once P1 is dead, they attack.
name: Default Team Duel
